thread:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — INC-472 | embeddings-eu latency spike detected at 15:02 UTC
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered: paging @maria, @kevin (primary/secondary). Spike observed on replicas in eu-west-1. Error rate 5% above baseline.
Maria G: I'm on it — grabbing logs now. primary oncall for the next 8h. starting investigation.
Kevin L: I'm standing by as secondary. If you need me to takeover traffic routing, ping me.
Maria G: Initial look — tailing nginx + model-runtime logs shows sustained 95th latency ~2200ms for /embeddings endpoint. KV-cache miss rate jumped.
Sarah P: Are customers impacted? Any major tenants? Which SLAs hit?
Maria G: Quick customer check: 3 high-volume tenants show elevated p99; no 503s so far, just slow responses. Satelite monitoring shows queue depth increased on worker-queue-embeddings.
Alex R: Possible KV cache eviction storm after yesterday's rollout? Runbook section 3 (cache-thrashing) https://rwd.atlassian.net/wiki/embeddings-runbook#cache-thrash
Maria G: Running suggested check:
```
kubectl -n inference exec -it svc/model-runtime-eu -- curl -s http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache
```
Looks like kv_cache_hits dropped to 12%.
Tia N: Suggest rollback to previous model variant on a subset or enable cache warmup. Can we pin a canary? :thinking:
Kevin L: I can initiate a lightweight canary rollback if Maria wants to coordinate; need approval if we pull global traffic.
Maria G: Going to open an ephemeral canary: spinning up model variant v2.3-warm on two pods with warmed cache. Will route 5% traffic.
oncall-bot: ACTION — created temporary canary deployment embeddings-canary-268345 | owner: Maria G | command: `helm upgrade --set variant=v2.3-warm embeddings-canary ./charts/embeddings`
Maria G: Canary up. warming with recent traffic replay. Monitoring p99 on canary now ~480ms after warmup.
Sarah P: Nice. Any regression in quality? We need to confirm embeddings cosine similarity within acceptable delta.
Alex R: Running eval against smoke prompt set (50 queries) — cosine delta < 0.002, looks fine.
Tia N: While canary stabilizes, what's our rollback criteria or next step? If canary holds at p99 < 700ms for 10min, we should promote.
Maria G: Agreed. If canary fails, rollback will be triggered and we throttle incoming requests to reduce queue depth. Setting a 12-minute observation window.
Kevin L: I updated routing policy to send 5% to canary. Command: `rwdctl route set embeddings --canary 5% --id embeddings-canary-268345`
incident-bot: NOTE — external customers XCorp and FinTools flagged elevated CPU in their dashboards; incident severity set to P2 and customer outreach initiated by CS.
Sarah P: I'm looping in CS to message affected customers. @maria please paste clear ETA once we promote or rollback.
Maria G: Noted. Logging actions and attaching graphs to INC-472.
-- 26 minutes later --
Maria G: Canary p99 stable at 520ms for 12m, kv_cache hits back to 78%. Queue depth dropping.
Tia N: :tada: Looks good. If we can hold another 10m, propose promote and scale down old pods.
Kevin L: After promote we should also file a follow-up ticket for cache eviction root cause analysis + improved warmup on deploy.
Maria G: Promoting now to 40% traffic, will ramp to 100% over 8 minutes if metrics hold.
oncall-bot: ACTION — routing updated, canary promoted to 40%.
Alex R: Observing p99 at 560ms across promoted group. No 503s. I recommend keep monitoring and prepare rollback plan but proceed with full promote.
Maria G: Ramping to 100% now.
incident-bot: UPDATE — metrics normalized. p99 back to baseline ~420ms. Customers seeing improved latencies per CS.
Sarah P: Customer outreach sent: message templates used, ETA communicated. CS will follow up if any regressions.
Maria G: Handoff note for next shift: primary-> Kevin L, secondary-> Tia N. I'll stay reachable for 30m post-handoff.
Kevin L: Acknowledge. I'll pick up monitoring at 18:30 UTC.
Maria G: Post-handoff actions created:
- RWD-1254 (Bug) — root cause: cache eviction triggered by k8s node churn on eu-west-1; owner: Alex R
- RWD-1255 (Task) — add automatic cache pre-warm step to rollout pipeline; owner: Tia N
- RWD-1256 (Postmortem) — schedule incident retro next Wed 16:00 UTC; owner: Maria G
- RWD-1257 (Action) — add runbook check: pre-deploy cache sanity check (docs update); owner: Kevin L
Kevin L: I've created the tracker ticket for handoff coverage notes RWD-HANDOFF-268345 and attached logs.
incident-bot: CREATED TICKETS [RWD-1254, RWD-1255, RWD-1256, RWD-1257, RWD-HANDOFF-268345]
Tia N: Quick note: there's a 4-hour lull in on-call coverage tomorrow 02:00-06:00 UTC; suggest swapping with EU oncall to cover. filing a rotation swap request.
Maria G: Acknowledged. I'll post in #eng-oncall-schedule and ping ops. If swap not available, ensure pager escalation to Kevin for that window.
Kevin L: Will hold primary and confirm overlap handoff at 18:25.
Sarah P: Thanks everyone — excellent coordination. Please add any additional artifacts to INC-472.
Maria G: Adding final logs and timeline to ticket. Handoff complete: primary=@Kevin L secondary=@Tia N. Leaving channel. :wave:
Kevin L: Taking over. Monitoring continues.
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: from Maria G to Kevin L | duration 8h | notes: canary promoted, follow-ups filed.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (P2 -> resolved) | root cause flagged for postmortem.
